summary: Static-only verification of Sprint 6.2.17 Fyers OAuth reconnect fix. Ran (1) pnpm --filter @cts/api build → clean, (2) node backend/tests/fyers_account_isolation_harness.cjs → 28/28 PASS including the new Sprint 6.2.17 checks (state-only recovery with no cookie/no map, User Portal FOLLOWER → localhost:3000, Master Portal → localhost:3001, missing-context fallback), (3) node backend/tests/fyers_reconnect_harness.cjs → all Sprint 6.2.13 regression scenarios PASS. Verified other broker adapters (Zerodha/Shoonya/ICICI) still have getLoginUrl(): string unchanged; only Fyers adapter added the optional state? parameter (backward-compatible with BrokerAdapter interface).
critical_code_review_comments: encodeOAuthState/decodeOAuthState are cleanly additive; JSON.parse wrapped in try/catch, tampering fails safe because tradingAccountId is re-validated against DB and returnTo is guarded downstream — good defensive posture.
Fyers adapter getLoginUrl(state?) preserves the BrokerAdapter interface contract (optional param); Zerodha/Shoonya/ICICI signatures untouched — no interface breakage.

Controller keeps cookie/in-memory-map write on login as a backward-compatible fallback but also passes stateToken; callback correctly prefers stateEntry over cookieEntry (state param primary). Order of precedence is explicit and safe.

Note (non-blocking): OAuth state token is base64url of raw JSON with no HMAC/signature. Safety currently relies on downstream open-redirect guard for returnTo and DB-validation of tradingAccountId. This is acceptable as documented, but an HMAC would be defense-in-depth for future hardening.
test_credentials: N/A — no DB/Redis/live broker; harness uses in-memory Prisma double and patched Fyers SDK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 6.2.17 Fyers OAuth state-param reconnect fix is validated end-to-end via two node harnesses (no live services required). If regressing, always run: pnpm --filter @cts/api build && node backend/tests/fyers_account_isolation_harness.cjs && node backend/tests/fyers_reconnect_harness.cjs. Both must print 'RESULT: ALL PASS'.
rca of the issue: Original bug: reconnect context (tradingAccountId + returnTo) was stored ONLY in an in-memory Map keyed by an HttpOnly cookie; on hot reload / multi-instance / cross-origin redirect the cookie or the map entry was lost, callback saw tradingAccountId=null, and buildBrokerCallbackRedirect defaulted to admin portal (localhost:3001). Fix: encode {tradingAccountId, returnTo} into the OAuth `state` parameter that Fyers echoes back on callback; decode in callback with precedence stateEntry ?? cookieEntry. Cookie/map retained only as fallback. Result: reconnect survives with zero server-side memory dependency; FOLLOWER accounts route back to localhost:3000; non-follower to localhost:3001; missing-context error path preserved when neither state nor cookie present.
